connector.name: Automox MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Official MCP server for Automox. Manage devices, patches, and policies in natural language.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package automox-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.automox. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AUTOMOX_ACCOUNT_UUID
env.description: Account UUID from Automox Settings > Secrets & Keys

env.name: AUTOMOX_ORG_ID
env.description: Numeric Automox organization ID. Recommended — required by most tools, optional for tools that don't need org context.
